name: UncleCode Competitive Coding Agent Benchmark
methodology: Each system receives the same isolated fixture, prompt, model target, timeout, and deterministic post-run checks. Scores come from files and executable behavior, never self-reported answers.

tasks.description: Honor a repository-local instruction without touching unrelated input.
tasks.prompt: Complete the task defined by the repository instructions. Verify the result before finishing.

files.AGENTS.md:
# Benchmark instruction

For this benchmark only, create `result.txt` with the exact UTF-8 content `LOCAL_RULE_OK` followed by one newline. Do not modify any existing file.

tasks.description: Rename a public symbol across files without leaving an alias or stale callsite.
tasks.prompt: Rename the exported `sum` function to `add`, update every caller, leave no compatibility alias or stale `sum` identifier, and run the provided test. Use the search_text tool for the stale-identifier search. Shell commands must be standalone and exact: `node test.mjs`, then either `sha256sum app.mjs math.mjs test.mjs` or `shasum -a 256 app.mjs math.mjs test.mjs`. Do not use a multiline shell script, shell wrapper, redirection, or a compound command for the search.

files.app.mjs:
import { sum } from './math.mjs';

export const total = sum(20, 22);

shellCommands: node test.mjs && sha256sum math.mjs app.mjs test.mjs
node test.mjs && shasum -a 256 math.mjs app.mjs test.mjs

tasks.description: Fix a Unicode correctness bug while preserving the existing ASCII contract.
tasks.prompt: Fix the slug implementation so the provided regression test passes. Preserve letters and decimal digits from every Unicode script, keep the ASCII behavior, add no dependency, and run the test. Shell commands must be fixture-scoped: use `node test.mjs` for verification and `sha256sum slug.mjs` or `sha256sum slug.mjs test.mjs` only for evidence. Do not use multiline shell, redirection, subshells, or other executables.
